credits.title: Coward
credits.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

credits.title: Seule la tendresse
credits.overview: Winter is hard as stone. If she still knew how to cry, Gaëlle would scream that she needs love. But between her father, who is struggling to regain control of his body after a stroke, and her friend Nolan, who is funny but really too stupid, will her cry encounter anything other than the icy echo of the forest?

credits.title: Case 137
credits.overview: When Internal Affairs officer Stéphanie investigates a young man severely injured during a chaotic Paris demonstration and finds no police misconduct, the routine case hits close to home upon her discovering the victim is from her native town.

credits.title: Colours of Time
credits.overview: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. credits.overview: Christopher, 17, is a young man of identity who lives with his father and sister in a suburban housing estate. Then an eclipse is announced and a family moves into the house next door.
